question: What extraordinary power manifests through muttering focused on an image?
premises: Muttering is performed in relation to an image.
It results in the breaking of pots and stones.
inference: Muttering focused on an image can produce the power to break pots and stones.
uncertainties: The token 'tasmi(n' appears truncated in the source.
plain_english: In that muttering upon an image, there is the breaking of pots and stones.
